entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi, yes... I have a VeloBand GPS Tracker and it's... it's not working. I'm a bit lost on what to do.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
I think it's a fault? It just won't sync with the app on my phone. I've tried everything the little booklet said to do. I'm worried it's broken.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. A sync issue is something our technical team can usually resolve pretty quickly. It might just need a specific reset sequence.
Oh, I don't know... that sounds complicated. It just seems defective to me. I'm not very good with these things. Can't you just help me? I just want something that works.
Of course, I'm here to help make this easy for you. Let me pull up your account to see what our options are. Can I get the order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 39 days ago. Let me just check the policy for you.
Alright, I've confirmed it. You're well within our 90-day return window. Since it seems defective, we can definitely process a full refund for you. No need to troubleshoot if you'd prefer not to.
Oh! Really? That's such a relief. So I can just send it back?

Yes, absolutely. I have just authorized the return in our system. I've sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email. Just place the band back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
